data.name: Mihra
data.gender_notes: Mihra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mihra means 'Moon' in Arabic and Urdu. The name Mihra carries the meaning “Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Mihra usually hope their child will grow to embody moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mihra is a name that is deeply connected to the natural world and the cycles of life. It represents the constant change and renewal that is a part of all things.
data.etymology: Mihra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mihra total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مِحْرَ
in_arabic.meaning: الجوهرة، الحجر النفيس، الحسن، الجمال، الفخر، الإشراق
in_arabic.long_meaning: أصل الاسم مِحْرَ، يعود إلى الحجر النفيس، المعروف بـالحجر المحر، وهو حجر نادر وجميل، ذو لون أزرق فاتح، يُستخدم فيصنع المجوهرات، والجوهرة، هي الحجر النفيس أو الحسن أو الجمال، ويُستخدم في القرآن الكريم، والكلمة تعني الإشراق والفخر والجمال، ويُعتبر الاسم مُصاحباً للخير والخُلوق المُمتازة، ويعكس شخصية شخص مُتقيًا، ومتواضعًا، ومتواصلًا، ومتفتحًا، ومتقدمًا، والمُطيع للله تعالى، والمُحترم لمُعتقداته، والمُحافظ على مُعتقداته، والمُستعد للصبر والصلاح

in_urdu.name: مِحْرَ
in_urdu.meaning: جوهرة، حجر نفیس، حسن، جمال، فخر، اشراق
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم مِحْرَ، جوهرة اور حجر نفیس کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، جو عرب میں بہت زیادہ مہرban ہوتا ہے، اس لیے اسے مِحْرَ کہا جاتا ہے، یہ حجر اور جوهرے دونوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے حسن، جمال اور فخر، اور وہی شخص کا نام ہو جائے گا جو خوبصورت ہو اور اچھا ہو، جو ہمارے دین میں بہت اہمیت کا حامل ہے، اس لیے اسے بہت سے لوگ اپنے بچوں کے لیے پسند کرتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: मिह्र
in_hindi.meaning: मोती, हीरा, सौंदर्य, सुंदरता, गर्व, प्रतिभा
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम मिह्र, मोती या हीरे के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, जो एक ऐसा पत्थर है जो भारत में बहुत प्रिय माना जाता है, इसका उपयोग सौंदर्य, सुंदरता, गर्व, प्रतिभा और अन्य गुणों के प्रतीक के रूप में किया जाता है, जो एक व्यक्ति को अच्छा बनाता है और उसकी अच्छाई को बढ़ाता है, यह नाम एक अच्छा विकल्प है जो एक बच्चे को अच्छा बनाने के लिए उपयुक्त है

in_pashto.name: مِحْرَ
in_pashto.meaning: جوهره، د ړخ، زړه، زړه، دښمن، دښمن
in_pashto.long_meaning: السم مِحْرَ، جوهره یا دړخ کې په عربي کې په کتېبونو کې لیکل کیږي، دړخ او جوهره ډیر ډیر ښه او زړه جوهره ښیي، دښمن کله چې دښمني کوي، زړه پکې ډکوي، دښمن زړه پکې ښکته کیږي، زړه پکې ښکته کیږي، دښمن کله چې دښمني کوي، په هغه مهال کې دښمن زړه پکې ښکته کیږي، ډیر ډیر زړه جوهره ښیي، جوهره یې دښمن کله چې پکې دښمني کوي، دښمن زړه پکې ښکته کیږي، دښمن کله چې دښمني کوي، زړه پکې ډکوي

in_english.name: Mihra
in_english.meaning: jewel, gem, beauty, charm, pride, radiance
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mihra is derived from the Arabic word for jewel or gem, which is a symbol of beauty, charm, and pride. The name Mihra is associated with qualities such as radiance, elegance, and refinement. In Islamic tradition, the name Mihra is considered a symbol of spiritual beauty and inner light. It is also associated with the qualities of kindness, compassion, and generosity. The name Mihra is a popular choice among Muslims, particularly in the Middle East and South Asia, where it is often given to girls born into families of high social status. The name Mihra is also associated with the concept of 'nur' or light, which is a central theme in Islamic theology.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mihra holds significant cultural importance in Islamic tradition, as the crescent moon is a universal symbol of Islam and is widely used as a decorative element in Islamic art, architecture, and calligraphy. Furthermore, the sighting of the crescent moon marks the beginning of the new Islamic month and the commencement of religious observances such as fasting during Ramadan.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Mihra represents continuity, renewal, and transformation. The Moon symbolizes the shifting phases in life and the divine guidance that illuminates the path during life's darkest moments. It is a reminder of Allah's constant watchfulness and care, and the cyclical nature of time. In Islamic literature, the moon is often used as a metaphor for wisdom, tranquility, and peace.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mihra is an Arabic name derived from the word 'mihr' meaning 'crescent moon'. It symbolizes the ever-changing cycle of life, reminding us of the transient nature of worldly possessions and the importance of staying connected to the divine through faith and spiritual growth.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mihra was a daughter of the Sassanid king Khosrow I Anushirvan (531-579 CE). The name Mihra carried significant weight in that era.

trends: Gaining popularity in Western Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Mihra remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
